summary: PHASE 1 cashier shift workflow verified end-to-end in the browser (frontend only, per request). All 7 shift scenarios pass: PIN login lands cashier on /pos, Start Shift overlay blocks selling with opening-cash defaulting to 0, negative opening cash is rejected (overlay stays open, no shift created), Start Shift with 1000 unlocks selling and shows banner + Close Shift button, reload/resume returns the same shift with NO duplicate and no overlay, a cash sale (Adhesive Bandage Box ₱145, tendered ₱200) completes with receipt SALE-20260912-00002, and Close Shift → Counted 1200 → shows reconciliation summary (Opening 1,000 / Cash Sales 200 / Cash In 0 / Cash Out 0 / Cash Refunds 0 / Expected 1,200 / Counted 1,200) with Difference ₱0.00 (Balanced); after Done the Start Shift overlay returns (shift is null).

issues: Receipt modal (New Sale / Print) overlays the top-right Close Shift button so a second sale/close attempt requires closing the receipt first. Not a blocker (New Sale button clears it), but consider auto-focusing/closing after a short delay or moving Close Shift out from behind the modal stack.
'POS session started' toast overlaps the top-right Close Shift button for ~3s after shift start, causing intermittent misclicks in automation (real users are fine).

critical_code_review_comments: Negative opening cash: UI silently keeps the overlay open with no visible error toast (backend returns 400 but frontend does not surface a message). Consider showing a toast/inline error so cashier knows why nothing happened.
Close Shift button can be occluded by receipt/toast overlays; increase z-index of the shift banner action buttons or auto-dismiss the receipt/toast sooner.

rca of the issue: Original PHASE 1 bug (cashier could not open a shift because shift UI existed only in back-office /shifts inaccessible to cashiers) is FIXED. POS.jsx now embeds the full Start/Resume/Close workflow, checkout sends shift_id, and backend routes_pos.py enforces open shift for employee sales and correctly deduplicates OPEN shifts per store+register. UI end-to-end confirms cashier flow works.
